description: Use this to check that an MCP server's tools are still the ones a person approved, like a lockfile: pass the lock you saved at approval (tool name to hash, as returned by watch or tool_card) and get, per tool, unchanged, changed (with any rise in risk), removed or new. Catches rug pulls, where a tool changes after approval, which MCP clients do not re-ask about. Which to use: verify_lock against your saved lock; watch for one server since a date; changes_since for many servers. Paid per server (see list_paid_tools). Reads the map only.

last_trip.description: Optional: how your previous call to a server 7Maps named went

ok.description: Did it do what you needed

surprise.description: Side effect you did not ask for

license_key.description: 7IT plan license key; else pay per call (x402)

lock.description: Tool name to hash, saved at approval

server.description: The server URL or its official registry name

name: verify_lock
title: Verify a pinned tool list (7Maps)
